lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno's voice went croak, croak, croak,
Is there a frog? That's not a joke!
Kiki smiled and handed tea,
It's just a scratchy voice, you see!
[chorus]
A frog in your throat, a frog in your throat,
Croaky voice, a scratchy note!
A frog in your throat, a frog in your throat,
Sip some water, clear that throat!
[verse]
It means your voice is rough and low,
A little hoarse and croaky, so
Clear your throat and sip a drink,
Your voice comes back quicker than you think!
[chorus]
A frog in your throat, a frog in your throat,
Croaky voice, a scratchy note!
A frog in your throat, a frog in your throat,
Sing it out, a happy note!
[outro]
So when you croak on every note,
You've got a frog right in your throat!
